an1.188:1.1: Koṇḍañña gained his nickname as he was the first person to realize the Dhamma after the Buddha ([sn56.11:14.3]()). His absence was due to his love of solitude, as expressed in his verses ([thag15.1:0.4]()). Due to this, he features rarely in the early texts, but the Buddha once saw him meditating ([ud7.6]()), and once came to show extreme devotion to the Buddha ([sn8.9[()).
